purpose: Working Copy execution bridge for the already-preregistered HERMES-LIVE-001 live-worker proof.
scope: Add one GitHub Actions workflow that runs the frozen HERMES-LIVE-001 controller with a real pinned Hermes worker.
Use the existing OPENAI_API_KEY repository secret as the single delegated provider credential.
Forward HERMES_HOME only at the Airlock worker boundary.
Upload the signed terminal report and runtime metadata as a GitHub Actions artifact.
explicitly_out_of_scope: changes to the frozen objective/evaluator/controller/worker boundary

trigger.reason: The runner starts once when this workflow is merged; the later human standing-tick merge does not recursively start another proof run.

operator_sequence: Import this ZIP at repository root in Working Copy.
Commit on feat/hermes-live-001-runner and open PR to main.
Merge only after CI is green.
The merge starts the real Hermes proof and the controller waits up to 900 seconds after first worker contact for the preregistered human main movement.
While it is waiting, merge the separate standing-tick control PR changing only .airlock/hermes-live-001-standing.json epoch 0 to 1.
Inspect the uploaded HERMES-LIVE-001 artifact; freeze if terminal_architecture_pass is true.
stop_rule: If the preregistered claim is earned and the suite remains green, freeze HERMES-LIVE-001. Do not add FOREIGN-001 work here.
